prompt: Matte clay 3D render of a small mechanical assembly on a neutral seamless backdrop. A sleek modular server block featuring a heavy, opaque housing with a thick latched cover fastened by a large padlock, completely obscuring the internal components. Clear physical arrangement of recognisable engineered parts, matte surfaces with moulding seams and contact shadows. Single soft key light, matte muted palette of soft grey and charcoal. Minimalist studio render.
